title: SessionMessage.metadata.modelVisibility
description: Stable JSON shape for model-visibility metadata carried on SessionMessage.metadata.modelVisibility. Decouples page visibility (the `visible` field) from model visibility (context assembly exclusion). Owned by agent-contracts/session; consumed by agent-context-engine assembly.

excluded.description: When true, context assembly MUST exclude this message from the model context regardless of the `visible` field.

reason.description: The VisibilityReason explaining why the message is force-included or force-excluded from the model context.

included.description: When true, context assembly MUST include this message in the model context even if the `visible` field is false. Inverse of `excluded`. Mutually exclusive with `excluded=true`. Canonical use case: a directed-Skill body persisted as a page-hidden USER message the model must see.
